summary.one_liner: PeerSuite is a decentralized peer-to-peer workspace project whose README says its development has moved to UmbraChat, a browser-based private chat app.
summary.what_it_does: The README is short and mostly a redirect notice. It says PeerSuite's development continues as UmbraChat, described as private, Discord-style chat that runs in the browser with peer-to-peer connections, no central server, and no account. It states that the workspace tools (kanban, documents, whiteboard) were not carried over, and that UmbraChat focuses on chat, audio, video, and screensharing. The README links to a browser extension for Chrome, Firefox, and Edge, and to a source repository. It gives no build or setup instructions for PeerSuite itself.
use_cases: audio and video calls between peers
how_to_run: Install the UmbraChat browser extension for Chrome, Firefox, or Edge (links in the README)
notable: Peer-to-peer design with no central server and no account required
Successor project UmbraChat carries the chat, audio, video, and screensharing features
Workspace tools (kanban, documents, whiteboard) were dropped in the move
caveats: Development has moved to UmbraChat; the PeerSuite workspace tools are no longer part of the project
README gives no setup instructions for PeerSuite itself
Install path is a browser extension, per the README links
